subject: Stakeholder mapping — Acme Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acme-commerce.com>, Ben Wallace <b.wallace@acme-commerce.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping — Acme Commerce

Hi Sophie / Ben —

Thanks again for taking time today — great to learn about Acme's plans to standardize recommendations across commerce and marketing. Quick recap and a couple of asks to keep momentum: 

1) Recap / decision criteria
- Primary goals: reduce latency for recommendations to <100ms, consolidate model infra, and reduce per-token inference costs.
- Success metrics: production latency percentile, cost per request, and model quality on your test prompts.

2) Immediate asks (can you help with these?):
- Share a stakeholder org chart or list so we can map the economic buyer, procurement, and security contacts (attached a lightweight template you can drop into). (attachment: stakeholder_template.xlsx)
- Who will be the economic buyer (CFO/Head of Product/Head of Engineering)?
- Are there any procurement or security review timelines/processes we should bake into a mutual action plan?

3) Next steps from our side
- I’ll draft a mutual action plan and estimate for a pilot (3–4 week POC) and loop in our solutions engineer for a technical kickoff.

Would you be able to share the org chart or point me to the right folks? If easier, cc’ing Aditya (solutions) to schedule a short intro with your security/procurement leads.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0187

Attachment: stakeholder_template.xlsx
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acme-commerce.com>

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. I grabbed the template and started filling it out — attaching an org chart export below. High level:

- Economic buyer is likely our CFO, Mark Davis (I’ll confirm).
- Procurement run by Tara Gomez in Vendor Management — she typically owns contracts and SLAs.
- Security/Privacy will be handled by Alex Chen on our Security Architecture team.

I’m attaching a quick export of the org chart (Acme_org_chart.pdf). Will confirm exact names and will introduce Tara / Alex if that helps.

Best,
Sophie
Head of Data Partnerships | Acme Commerce
Sophie.Turner@acme-commerce.com

Attachment: Acme_org_chart.pdf

Great — thanks Sophie. A couple quick items while you confirm: 

- Attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) draft with milestones we typically see for a pilot (intro, technical kickoff, pilot run, evaluation). Can you review and let us know if internal procurement/security windows would push any of the dates? (attachment: mutual_action_plan.docx)
- If Mark is the economic buyer, would you be comfortable making a short intro (email) so we can align on business metrics and ROI?
- For procurement, do you have an existing vendor questionnaire or SOW template we should align to?

Proposed immediate next step: 30-minute intro with Tara and Alex this week or next to align on security/compliance requirements and procurement cadence. Aditya / Rishi can take the technical and commercial notes respectively. 

If you’d like, I can draft the intro email with suggested bullets for Mark, Tara, and Alex to make it quick on your side.

Thanks —

Hi Sophie / Marissa —

Thanks for looping me in. I can host the technical kickoff with Aditya on our side. A couple items we typically need from procurement/security to scope the pilot:

- Target SLA/uptime expectations and any required penalties
- Data residency / isolation requirements (if any)
- Any required third-party attestations (SOC2, ISO 27001) or questionnaires — we can provide our SOC2 report and security pack.

Sophie — if you can make the intros to Tara and Alex I’ll prepare our security pack and a short onboarding checklist to speed the review. Also linking the HubSpot company record for visibility: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Thanks — I confirmed the internal contacts and attached the org chart export. Putting the names here to make intros easier:

- Mark Davis <mdavis@acme-commerce.com> — CFO (likely economic buyer)
- Tara Gomez <tara.gomez@acme-commerce.com> — Head of Vendor Management / Procurement
- Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme-commerce.com> — Security Architecture (will own security review)

We have a typical vendor review cadence — procurement will run a 2–3 week questionnaire + contract review, security will do a concurrent 1–2 week technical review (SOC2 + architecture diagrams). If you can share your SOC2 and a short onboarding checklist, that would help speed things up. 

I’ll send a single intro email to Mark, Tara, and Alex this afternoon. For timing, our internal target is to complete vendor selection by end of Q2 so a pilot in April would fit nicely.

Thanks —
Sophie
Head of Data Partnerships | Acme Commerce
